prompt: A member of your group project sends their section at midnight before the deadline, full of gaps. The others want to remove their name from the submission entirely. What is the fairest response?

options.text: Suggest the group quickly fill the worst gaps, keep the name on, and talk honestly afterwards about the late timing
Agree to remove the name without telling that member
Rewrite their whole section yourself and say nothing
Submit it exactly as it is so everyone shares the low mark equally

explanation: Fixing what you can for the deadline while addressing the lateness honestly afterwards is fairer than secretly erasing someone's contribution.
